# Source and scope

- Upstream: https://github.com/XBuilderLAB/cheat-on-content
- Revision: `97aec3e3dfcc8ba8c080c641432832fa39d12957`
- License: MIT. The original copyright and complete permission notice are in `LICENSE` in this directory.
- Included: the root routing document, `cheat-seed`, `cheat-trends`, `cheat-recommend`, and the script-pattern template used as read-only references by the workbench.

This is a reference subset for this application, not a complete installable skill distribution. The application reads selected sections and applies its own explicit workflow contract in `内容方法/cheat-on-content/WORKFLOW.md`. It does not execute the upstream shell scripts, hooks, prediction workflow, or commands. Internal links to files outside this subset refer to the full upstream repository at the revision above.

The original source files are preserved. Their example statistics and performance predictions are not evidence of this application's accuracy. No calibrated prediction or numerical scoring is enabled in the workbench.
